body:
Follow-up to #261, bringing in what the fp-monorepo audit (Duncan-Haywood/fp-monorepo#6410) turned up.

- **Landing work, step 7.** Cloud sessions are told to commit and push before they stop, and a stop hook asks again while the working tree is dirty. That end-of-session push is how no-op runs here left their run logs on branches. Step 7 now says to leave nothing to push: discard unshipped edits (`git restore`) and drop your own unshipped commits (`git reset --keep HEAD~1`).
- **Steps 2 and 5 no longer say to delete branches.** The session git proxy refuses branch deletion: I tried twice on #261's branch and it's still there. Runs would fail at that step. Spent branches are better handled by GitHub's "Automatically delete head branches" setting, which is currently off (about 255 merged branches remain here).

`python site/build.py` prints `ok: 233 projects, 2146 tests`.
